|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The remaster prints a location destiny bonus without the original draw qualification. The period One Rule preserves the once-per-player-deploy-phase cap for the single eligible site. The period supplement separately explains the eligible generic locations.
